Package top.brmc.bukkitplatform.towerdefense.tower.towerabstract

Class EntityTower

java.lang.Object
top.brmc.bukkitplatform.towerdefense.tower.ActiveTower
top.brmc.bukkitplatform.towerdefense.tower.towerabstract.EntityTower
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Listener
Direct Known Subclasses:
BeastTower, FloatTower, KamikazeTower, LightningTower, TrapTower
public abstract class EntityTower extends ActiveTower
实体防御塔抽象类 用于生成和管理实体类型的防御塔(如陷阱,实体等)

只能在主线程调用: 子类会在攻击时生成或管理 Bukkit 实体.

关键边界行为: 塔已损坏时不生成任何实体, 也不触发生成逻辑.
